_about: Hand-written, genre-level descriptions used to enrich song documents for retrieval (src/rag/ingestion.py). These describe each GENRE in general, not individual songs, so they never add made-up facts about a specific track. Editing this file triggers an automatic re-index.

pop.style: catchy, polished mainstream songs built around big hooks and choruses
pop.characteristics: radio-friendly production, strong vocal melodies, verse-chorus structure, synths and programmed drums

indie pop.style: melodic pop with an independent, slightly quirky or dreamy feel
indie pop.characteristics: jangly guitars or warm synths, airy vocals, bedroom-pop and lo-fi textures, wistful or nostalgic tone

hip hop.characteristics: rhythmic spoken-word delivery, heavy bass, 808s and trap hi-hats, sampled loops, confident or gritty attitude

r&b.characteristics: soulful, sensual vocals, groove-based rhythms, lush harmonies, slick modern production, late-night atmosphere

soul.style: neo soul: warm, emotional vocal music rooted in gospel and classic soul
soul.characteristics: expressive vocals, live instrumentation, jazzy chords, laid-back grooves, intimate and heartfelt

rock.characteristics: electric guitars, driving drums, bass, riffs and solos, anthemic choruses, live band energy

edm.style: big, high-energy electronic dance music made for festivals
edm.characteristics: synth leads, build-ups and drops, four-on-the-floor kicks, heavy sidechain, euphoric and loud

latin.style: latin pop, reggaeton and tropical music
latin.characteristics: Spanish-language vocals, dembow and syncopated rhythms, percussion, danceable and sunny, party energy

alt rock.style: alternative rock outside the mainstream rock tradition
alt rock.characteristics: distorted or chiming guitars, introspective lyrics, moody or angsty tone, grunge and post-punk influences

punk.characteristics: short songs, power chords, shouted vocals, raw production, fast tempos, aggressive and energetic

metal.characteristics: heavily distorted guitars, fast double-kick drums, screamed or powerful vocals, dark and intense, loud

synthpop.style: pop built around synthesizers, often with an 80s feel
synthpop.characteristics: analog synths, drum machines, retro and nostalgic tone, neon and night-drive atmosphere, danceable

k-pop.characteristics: highly polished production, genre-blending songs, group vocals and rap verses, catchy hooks, energetic

funk.characteristics: syncopated bass lines, tight drums, rhythmic guitar, horns, very danceable, playful and upbeat

jazz.style: improvisational music built on swing and complex harmony
jazz.characteristics: saxophone, trumpet, piano, upright bass and brushed drums, often instrumental, smooth and sophisticated, good background music

blues.style: guitar and vocal music rooted in the blues scale
blues.characteristics: twelve-bar progressions, bending guitar lines, raw emotional vocals, slow to mid tempo, soulful and gritty

country.characteristics: twangy vocals, acoustic and steel guitars, fiddle, storytelling lyrics, small-town and heartfelt themes

folk.style: acoustic, song-centered folk and indie folk
folk.characteristics: acoustic guitar, banjo, soft vocals and harmonies, organic and earthy, introspective storytelling

acoustic.style: stripped-back songs played on acoustic instruments
acoustic.characteristics: acoustic guitar or piano, intimate vocals, unplugged and warm, gentle and calm, coffee-shop feel

classical.style: orchestral, piano and chamber music in the classical tradition
classical.characteristics: instrumental, no vocals, strings and piano, dynamic and expressive, calm focus music, good for studying

ambient.characteristics: drones, pads and soundscapes, mostly instrumental, slow and spacious, meditative, non-distracting, good for focus and sleep

chill.characteristics: mellow beats, soft synths, relaxed grooves, dreamy and hazy, low-key background music for studying or unwinding

house.characteristics: steady four-on-the-floor beat around 120-128 BPM, soulful vocal samples, warm bass, danceable club music

techno.characteristics: driving kick drums, dark minimal synths, mostly instrumental, mechanical and futuristic, long builds

reggae.characteristics: offbeat guitar skank, deep bass, relaxed one-drop rhythm, sunny and laid-back, positive vibes
